A '''Kinetic Energy Vest''' was a type of heavy [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] worn by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who wielded an [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]. The vest was covered in composite [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramics]] and was designed to absorb and dissipate the kinetic energy from incoming projectiles. The vest was part of the system worn by the soldier, upon which the [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] was attached. The Kinetic Energy Vest also featured an in-built [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a four-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] range, a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] for rescue parties to track, an a reserve power cell.<ref name="EGWT" />
